title: MCA Extends CRA-4 Filing Deadline to December 31, 2026, Without Additional Fees!
content:
# MCA Extends CRA-4 Filing Deadline to December 31, 2026, Without Additional Fees!

Hello everyone! Ek important update hai. The Government has announced a significant relaxation for companies regarding the filing of Form CRA-4.

The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) has extended the deadline for filing the Cost Audit Report in XBRL format (Form CRA-4) for the financial year 2025-26. This extension comes as a relief, allowing companies more time to comply without incurring extra costs.

Here are the key details:

*   **Form:** CRA-4 (Cost Audit Report in XBRL format)
*   **Applicable Financial Year:** 2025-26
*   **New Due Date:** December 31, 2026
*   **Additional Fees:** No additional fees will be levied for filings made up to the new extended deadline.
*   **Official Communication:** This extension has been granted vide General Circular No. 06/2026 dated October 27, 2026.

This is a welcome move by the MCA, considering various representations from stakeholders regarding difficulties in timely filing. Companies and professionals should utilize this extended period to ensure seamless compliance.
